rows.title: O.O Kalu esq
rows.subtitle: Principal Partner
rows.body:
O.O.Kalu, Esq. is an accomplished legal practitioner and the Principal Partner at O.O. Kalu & Associates, a premier legal practice based in Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria. He brings extensive expertise in Natural Resources & Environmental Law, Fundamental Rights Litigation, and Regulatory Compliance, blending robust trial advocacy with an elite multi-disciplinary background. He holds an LLB and a BA in History from Imo State University, alongside a Master of Arts in History and Diplomatic Studies from the University of Port Harcourt.
Beyond his courtroom leadership at his firm, Barrister Offia brings an international perspective to corporate dispute resolution. He holds professional certifications in Conflict Analysis and Negotiation and Conflict Management from the United States Institute of Peace (USIP), Washington, DC. This elite blend of diplomatic insights and legal acumen allows him to seamlessly lead firm litigation, steer dense regulatory corporate frameworks, and orchestrate high-stakes out-of-court resolutions.

rows.title: Fortune Nathan M., Esq.
rows.subtitle: Senior Associate
rows.body: Fortune Nathan is a Senior Associate at O.O. Kalu & Associates, Owerri, with over 15 years of post-qualification experience in litigation, legal advisory, contract review, regulatory compliance, and dispute resolution. She has strong expertise in electricity law and regulatory practice, advising clients on consumer-related disputes, contractual obligations, and compliance with sector regulatory requirements. Fortune also heads the firm's Family Law practice, representing clients in matrimonial disputes, divorce, and child custody matters. Her broader practice spans corporate advisory, due diligence, risk assessment, and policy interpretation, with a track record across private law firms and government service. She is known for sound legal judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and effective client representation.

rows.title: BARR. S. C. MBAOMA.
rows.subtitle: ASSOCIATE PARTNER
rows.body:
Barr. S.C.MBAOMA is a Nigerian legal practitioner and Associate Partner at O.O.KALU & ASSOCIATE LAWFIRM, with specialty in Property Law Practice and Educational Law.
 
His legal practice encompasses land and real estate transactions, property documentation, tenancy and lease matters, property development, construction related disputes, contracts, negotiations, arbitration, alternative dispute resolution and litigation.
He also advises on Educational Law and regulatory matters, with particular interest in institutional governance, regulatory compliance, education related contracts and disputes involving educational institutions and stakeholders.
Barr. Mbaoma combines legal practice with experience in Project Management, education, research and professional development, providing practical, strategic and client focused legal solutions.

PROPERTY LAW;
Land and Real Estate | Property Transactions | Tenancy & Leases | Property Development/Management | Construction Disputes.
 
EDUCATIONAL LAW:
Education Regulation | Institutional Governance | Compliance | Education Contracts | Dispute Resolution
 
OTHER PRACTICE AREAS:
Contracts & Negotiations | Arbitration & ADR | Civil Litigation
 
PROFESSIONAL PHILOSOPHY:
Professionalism. Integrity. Knowledge. Results.

rows.title: Corporate and Environmental Law
rows.body: We advise clients on regulatory compliance, environmental impact assessments, pollution liability, and sustainability obligations under Nigerian law. From our Owerri office, we help businesses operate responsibly while protecting communities and ecosystems across Imo State and beyond.

rows.title: Litigation & Arbitration
rows.body: Advocacy before the Nigerian courts and in domestic and international arbitration.
rows.meta: Our advocates appear at the Federal High Court, State High Courts, the Court of Appeal, and the Supreme Court of Nigeria, and sit in arbitrations under the Arbitration and Mediation Act 2023, LCA, RCICAL, and ICC rules. Every matter is prepared for hearing from the first week.
rows.bullets:
Commercial trials & appeals
Domestic & international arbitration
Banking, finance & recovery disputes
Shareholder & fiduciary claims
Election and public law litigation

rows.title: Energy & Natural Resources
rows.body: Upstream, midstream, and power mandates under the Petroleum Industry Act.
rows.meta: We provide counsel on the legal framework governing solid minerals, land use, and community resource rights. We guide clients through licensing, joint ventures, community engagement, and regulatory compliance in Nigeria's natural resources sector.
rows.bullets: We support clients in power, oil, gas, and renewable energy transactions. Our work covers project structuring, power purchase agreements, regulatory approvals, and dispute resolution, helping energy businesses navigate Nigeria's evolving energy market.

rows.title: Fundamental Rights Law
rows.body: We are staunch defenders of constitutionally guaranteed rights. We represent individuals, groups, and institutions in actions for enforcement of fundamental human rights, unlawful detention, discrimination, and abuse of power before courts in Owerri and across Nigeria.
rows.meta: We represent institutions and individuals before Nigerian financial and sector regulators and law enforcement, and we build compliance programmes — AML/CFT, NDPA data protection, competition — that hold up under examination rather than only on paper.

rows.title: Intellectual Property & Technology
rows.body: Brand, patent, and data protection counsel for Nigeria's technology economy.
rows.meta: We register and enforce rights at the Trademarks, Patents and Designs Registry, advise fintechs on CBN and NDPC obligations, and treat intellectual property as commercial infrastructure: protected where it creates leverage, licensed where it creates revenue.
rows.bullets:
Trademark registration & enforcement
Patents, designs & trade secrets
NDPA data protection compliance
Fintech & payments licensing
Technology transfer (NOTAP) agreements

rows.title: Real Estate & Infrastructure
rows.body: Title, entitlement, and project finance for significant Nigerian developments.
rows.meta: We conduct title investigation and perfection under the Land Use Act, secure Governor's consent, and shepherd developments and PPP infrastructure projects through approvals, financing, and the disputes ambitious construction attracts.
rows.bullets:
Acquisitions, title perfection & Governor's consent
Development & AMAC/Lagos planning approvals
Commercial leasing
PPP and infrastructure projects
Construction disputes

rows.title: Negotiation and Conflict Management
rows.body: We believe the best disputes are those resolved wisely. We lead high-stakes negotiations, mediations, and alternative dispute resolution, helping clients secure commercial outcomes without protracted litigation, while preserving critical business relationships.
